contract_term.value: The term of Contract shall commence on or around September 1, 2025 and shall remain in effect until August 31, 2030, unless otherwise terminated. USask reserves the right to extend the Contract for one additional three year and one additional two year extension, for a maximum potential Contract period of ten (10) years.
contract_term.quote: The term of Contract shall commence on or around September 1, 2025 and shall remain in effect until August 31, 2030, unless otherwise terminated in accordance with the terms outlined herein. USask reserves the right to extend the Contract for one additional three year and one additional two year extension, for a maximum potential Contract period of ten (10) years, or for subsequent project stages, or re-tender the Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) Software.

scope_of_deliverables.value: The University of Saskatchewan is requesting Proposals for the provision and/or installation of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) Software (see Appendix B).
scope_of_deliverables.quote: The University of Saskatchewan, as represented by Procurement, is requesting Proposals for the provision and/or installation of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) Software (see Appendix B) in accordance with conditions stated herein.

value: A table of contents of all presented material.
An outline of your corporate structure and ownership, complete with a list of the names of all the owners of the company and/or officers of the corporation, and a company organizational chart.
A complete description of the duration and extent of your company's experience, competence and reliability in handling similar projects.
A list of proposed personnel, corresponding job function, title, qualifications and experience required to facilitate any subsequent Contract.
A clear indication of services that will be provided.
The pricing structure, in Canadian dollars (see Section 2.4 – Pricing structure), for all proposed equipment and/or services.
A sample of Proponent's service/maintenance agreement.
Submission of relevant references. Provide a minimum of three (3) references for similar services, to include: company name, contact name, title, telephone number and email address if available.
A summary of sustainability initiatives (see Section 2.3 – Sustainability).

A summary of any value added benefits or in-kind contributions, any opportunities for recognition, must be approved under University Policy #5.07 see website: https://policies.usask.ca/policies/advancement/gift-in-kind-identification-and-appraisal.php#AuthorizationandApproval Discounts, “in-kind” contributions, value added benefits or incentives in the form of laboratory consumables and/or chemicals cannot be considered as the University has contracts in place for these commodities.
A clear indication of services that will be brokered to third parties, including usage of any USask in-house services.
Completed Validation of Proposal and Acceptance of Contractual Provisions (see Appendix A).
Completed pricing structure in electronic format (Appendix D – Pricing Structure).
Completed HECVAT or Software As a Service Form (Appendix E – Software as a Service Vendor Form)

Disclosure of any and all judgments, pending or expected litigation, or other real or potential reversals which might materially affect the viability or stability of the Proponent's organization; or warrant that no such condition is known to exist.
Proposal must be dated and signed in the firm or corporate name and must bear the signature of an officer or agent duly authorized to execute contracts for the Proponent.

Joint Proposals must be dated and signed in the firm or corporate name of the primary Proponent and must bear the signature of a principal duly authorized to execute contracts for the primary Proponent.
Proposal validity period of one hundred and twenty (120) days from the closing date.
Proponent accepts without modification all Contractual Provisions outlined in Section 3.0 and the Conditions included.

Proponent accepts without modification all Contractual Provisions... A.3 (continued): Yes or Yes, with the following proposed revisions.

value: The Proponent must be the direct provider of the services. Proposals from third-party resellers, intermediaries, or distributors will not be considered.
Proponents must demonstrate the capacity to meet the following requirements during the anticipated term of the Master Services Agreement (if awarded), expected to be 5 years.
mandatory_technical_requirements.quote: The Proponent must be the direct provider of the services. Proposals from third-party resellers, intermediaries, or distributors will not be considered. The Proponent must demonstrate direct ownership, management, and delivery of the Services outlined in this RFP without reliance on external resellers. Proponents must demonstrate the capacity to meet the following requirements during the anticipated term of the Master Services Agreement (if awarded), expected to be 5 years:

evaluation_criteria.quote: a) TECHNICAL & AI PLATFORM SERVICES 30; b) OPTIONAL SERVICES 5; c) PROFESSIONAL SERVICES 5; d) PROPONENT QUALIFICATIONS 10; e) SUPPORT & MANAGEMENT 10; f) COST 30; g) UNIVERSITY BENEFIT & SUSTAINABILITY 5; h) INDIGENOUS PARTICIPATION 5; TOTAL OF 100 Points

pricing_structure.value: Pricing structure must be shown in Canadian dollars, Goods and Services Tax (GST) and Provincial Sales Tax (PST) excluded. Pricing structure quoted should be DDP Incoterms 2010 USask. Costs should be inclusive of all relevant elements including, but not limited to: Taxes, Duty, Pricing formula(e), Installation charges, Maintenance fees, Upgrades, Training, and Value added benefits. The pricing structure should be firm for five (5) years of the Contract, with adjustments permitted based on substantiated changes in the Service Provider's costs, not to exceed the rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI).
pricing_structure.quote: Pricing structure must be shown in Canadian dollars, Goods and Services Tax (GST) and Provincial Sales Tax (PST) excluded. Pricing structure quoted should be DDP Incoterms 2010 USask. Costs should be inclusive of all relevant elements including, but not limited to the following: Pricing structure in Canadian funds. Taxes, shown separately if applicable. Duty, if applicable. Pricing formula(e). D.D.P. Incoterms 2010 terms. Installation charges. Maintenance fees. Upgrades. Training. Value added benefits.

insurance_requirements.quote: 1. Commercial General Liability Insurance: With a limit of not less than FIVE MILLION CANADIAN DOLLARS ($5,000,000.00 CAD) inclusive per occurrence for bodily injury (including death) and damage to property including loss of use thereof. 2. Cybersecurity Liability Insurance: With a limit of not less than FIVE MILLION CANADIAN DOLLARS ($5,000,000.00 CAD) inclusive per occurrence for cybercrime hacking, viruses, worms, denial of service attacks, data breach and ransomware liability insurance.

references_required.quote: Submission of relevant references. Provide a minimum of three (3) references for similar services, to include: company name, contact name, title, telephone number and email address if available.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Proponents may be contacted after the RFP closing to arrange for presentations to clarify Proposals, product demonstrations and/or an inspection of their operations. This may or may not be requested.

vendor_experience_required.value: Demonstrated ability to work in a large university environment or an organization of similar complexity. Relevant experience, competence, and reliability in handling similar projects.
